title: 第十章 商业互吹第九章 洪荒之力396战队
lines: 当396战队轰轰烈烈成立的时候，在一行人隔壁的包间里，也有五只酒杯清脆的碰在一起。
“呵呵，欢迎几位加入我周旭阳的战队。几位都是我们沪政大学最顶尖的高手，这次的城际挑战赛，请大家和我一起努力，咱们联手拿个好成绩回来。”周旭阳端着酒杯，带着礼貌的微笑向面前的几个人说道。
在周旭阳身边，换了一身简单装束，略施淡妆的林曦雨也同样端着酒杯站在旁边。只不过，林曦雨的酒杯里装着的就是饮料了。
“周哥把咱们哥几个凑在一起，再加上周哥你自己水平也不差，只要大伙儿都认真点，最少能进八强，如果运气够好，冠军也不是没可能。”
在周旭阳的另外一边，一个略显肥胖的男生笑了笑，带着几分自负的说道。
“那是啊，谁不知道许天哥是咱们沪政第一高手？上单王者五百点！还有庄小稣也是大师段位吧？有你们两位给咱们压阵，进个八强还不是手拿把攥？”另外一边，一个高瘦的青年也笑着吹捧了几句。
听到高瘦青年的话，包间里的另外两人都露出满意的笑来。大师段位的庄小稣是个标准的糙汉子形象，脸上长满了青春痘。
“哈哈，柳青你也太谦虚了，你是艾欧尼亚的钻石，含金量不同，在我们这儿上个大师王者也是轻松的，关键是咱们的队伍位置刚好互补，只要没有变态出现，真的是可以争一下冠军。”
虽然柳青的段位没其他两人高，但一区的钻一，其实骨子里是优于其他区的大师王者的，在三人里面，柳青的水平应该是最高的。
倒也不全是商业互吹，城际赛出高手的概率还是比较低的，尤其是今年的主要参赛队伍来自大学，也是lol的一次校园推广，一支队伍有一个王者真不容易了，毕竟全国数千万的玩家。
“呵呵，这个城际邀请赛我倒是听说过，去年夺冠的队伍，好像也就是还行吧。两个王者一个大师，还都是人机区的。老实说，今年要不是周哥你叫我来，这个比赛我是不打算参加的。”胖胖的许天端起酒杯又喝了一口，傲气的对周旭阳说道，他是祖安的王者，并不是一般郊区能比的，在lol鄙视链里，一区看不起其他所有区，二区祖安又看不起其他郊区。
“哎！也不能这么说，城际邀请赛上的高手嘛，还是有几个的。好歹最后到半决赛的时候，也是会有职业战队的教练去看的。”庄小稣倒是怕把周旭阳惹得不高兴，赶紧说了一句。
周旭阳组织这支队伍，给每个人都塞了一个三千块的红包，学校选拔完成，再给他们每个人三千块的“训练补助”，以他们的水平简直就是送钱，躺着拿6000块，对大学生来说真的是一笔巨款，更不用说，后面比赛只要能进八强还有奖励，这也引起了柳青他们的兴趣。
“嘿！我倒是同意许哥说的。就城际赛这几根葱，算什么高手？”柳青在一旁也撇了撇嘴，笑着说道，“虽然城际赛是线下赛，但是规格跟线上的英雄联盟黄金大奖赛没得比吧？之前的黄金大奖赛也有几支队伍邀请我加入。不过快毕业了没心情搭理他们。”
“呃……”庄小稣虽然仍然有心为周旭阳捧场，但是听到“英雄联盟黄金大奖赛”这几个字，他的话也实在是说不出口了，柳青和许天已经进入了装逼环节。
“呵呵，黄金大奖赛我也参加了。不过实在是不行，高手太多。我跟几个平时玩的好的哥们组队，在网吧里训练了一个半月，最后也就是进了三十二强就被淘汰了。归根到底，就是自己菜！”许天说着，又端起酒杯喝了一口。
许天嘴上说着“水平菜”，可在座的谁听不出来？他这哪里是在说自己真的菜？分明就是炫耀！
不过，许天这炫耀倒是也让庄小稣和柳青说不出话来。英雄联盟黄金大奖赛已经可以算得上是国内线上数一数二的比赛了。除了职业选手被限制不准参赛之外，基本上在国服出没的各路高手全都会组队参加。
能够在黄金大奖赛上闯入三十二强，这水平已经绝对超过了许天郊区王者的身份，完全可以算得上是进入一区王者的圈子了。
古龙说得好，有人的地方就有江湖，英雄联盟游戏里也是一样。一个郊区王者，你的id人家根本就不认！
别看许天在沪政大学牛，号称沪政第一高手，但是真进了高手圈子，他一个郊区王者就是弟弟。人家真正的一区王者谁知道你是谁啊？
但是进过一次黄金大奖赛三十二强，江湖地位立刻就不同了。至少哪怕是一区的王者，看到这个id的时候也不会再说“这人是谁啊？菜鸟吧？没印象”。
“哇！许天哥你这就过分了！过分了啊！都进三十二强了，还觉得自己菜？那我们这些人可怎么办？”庄小稣立刻就夸张的大叫起来。
柳青倒是仍旧很矜持骄傲的样子，不过在看许天的时候，眼神中挑衅的意味明显就收敛了许多，甚至带上了几分敬畏的味道。
这就是黄金大奖赛三十二强的影响力。
（感谢太阳的后裔王、全皮肤的小手的十万豪赏，成就时代盟主霸业，感谢！！！）

content_en:
When Team 396 was established with great fanfare, there were five wine glasses clinking together in the private room next to the group of people.
"Haha, I welcome you to join my team, Zhou Xuyang. They are all the top players from our Huzheng University. Please work hard with me in this intercity challenge. Let's work together to get good results." Zhou Xuyang said to the people in front of him with a polite smile while holding the wine glass.
Next to Zhou Xuyang, Lin Xiyu, who had changed into a simple outfit and put on light makeup, was also standing next to him holding a wine glass. However, Lin Xiyu's wine glass contained only drinks.
"Brother Zhou has brought us brothers together, and Brother Zhou is not bad at your own level. As long as everyone is serious, we can at least enter the quarterfinals. If we are lucky enough, it is not impossible to win the championship."
On the other side of Zhou Xuyang, a slightly fat boy smiled and said with a bit of arrogance.
"That's right. Who doesn't know that Brother Xu Tian is our top master in Shanghai politics? He has 500 points in the top lane! And Zhuang Xiaosu is also in the master level, right? With the two of you holding the battle for us, we can't reach the top eight with a handful of hands?" On the other side, a tall and thin young man also smiled and praised a few words.
Hearing what the tall and thin young man said, the other two people in the private room smiled with satisfaction. Zhuang Xiaosu, who is in the master rank, has a standard image of a rough guy, with his face covered with acne.
"Haha, Liu Qing, you are too humble. You are a diamond of Ionia, with a different gold content. It is easy to become the master king here. The key is that our team's positions complement each other. As long as there are no perverts, we can really compete for the championship."
Although Liu Qing's rank is not as high as the other two, Dian Yi from District 1 is actually better than the Master King from other districts. Among the three, Liu Qing's level should be the highest.
It’s not all business talk. The probability of a top player in the intercity competition is still relatively low, especially since this year’s main participating teams are from universities and it is also a campus promotion of lol. It is not easy for a team to have a champion. After all, there are tens of millions of players across the country.
"Haha, I have heard of this inter-city invitational tournament. The team that won last year seemed to be just okay. There are two kings and one master, and they are all from the man-machine area. To be honest, if you hadn't asked me to come this year, Brother Zhou, I wouldn't have planned to participate in this competition. "Yes." The fat Xu Tian took another sip from his wine glass and said proudly to Zhou Xuyang, he is the king of Zuan, and he is not comparable to other suburbs. In the LoL contempt chain, District One looks down on all other districts, and District Two, Zuan, looks down on other suburbs.
"Hey! You can't say that. There are still a few masters in the inter-city invitational tournament. At least in the semi-finals, there will be coaches from professional teams to watch." Zhuang Xiaosu was afraid of making Zhou Xuyang unhappy, so he quickly said something.
Zhou Xuyang organized this team and gave everyone a red envelope of 3,000 yuan. After the school selection was completed, each of them was given a "training subsidy" of 3,000 yuan. With their level, it was like giving away money. 6,000 yuan was really a huge sum of money for college students. Not to mention, there would be rewards for reaching the top eight in the following games, which also aroused the interest of Liu Qing and the others.
"Hey! I agree with what Brother Xu said. With just a few green onions in the inter-city competition, how can you be considered a master?" Liu Qing curled her lips and said with a smile, "Although the inter-city competition is an offline competition, the specifications are not comparable to the online League of Legends Golden Grand Prix, right? Several teams in the previous Golden Grand Prix also invited me to join. But I am about to graduate and I am not in the mood to deal with them."
"Uh..." Although Zhuang Xiaosu still wanted to cheer for Zhou Xuyang, he couldn't say anything when he heard the words "League of Legends Golden Grand Prix". Liu Qing and Xu Tian had already entered the show-off stage.
"Haha, I also participated in the Golden Grand Prix. But it was really not good, there were too many masters. I teamed up with a few good friends and trained in the Internet cafe for a month and a half. In the end, I entered the top 32 and was eliminated. In the final analysis, it is my own choice!" Xu Tian said, picking up the wine glass and taking a sip.
Xu Tian said "horizontal dishes", but who here couldn't hear it? How is he saying that he is really good? It’s obviously just showing off!
However, Xu Tian's show off left Zhuang Xiaosu and Liu Qing speechless. The League of Legends Golden Grand Prix can already be regarded as one of the best online competitions in China. Except for professional players who are not allowed to participate, basically all the masters who appear in the national server will form teams to participate.
Being able to break into the top 32 in the Golden Grand Prix, this level has definitely surpassed Xu Tian's status as the king of the suburbs, and can be regarded as entering the circle of the king of the first district.
Gu Long said it well, where there are people, there are rivers and lakes, and the same is true in the League of Legends game. A suburban king, people don’t recognize your ID at all!
Although Xu Tian was great at Huzheng University and was known as the number one master of Huzheng, when he really entered the circle of masters, he was a suburban king and his younger brother. Who knows who you are, the real king of District 1?
But after entering the top thirty-two of the Golden Grand Prix once, his status in the world was immediately different. At least even the king of District 1 will no longer say "Who is this person? A rookie, right? No impression" when he sees this ID.
"Wow! Brother Xu Tian, ​​you are going too far! You are going too far! You have already entered the top 32, and you still think you are inferior? What are we going to do?" Zhuang Xiaosu immediately shouted exaggeratedly.
Liu Qing still looked very reserved and proud, but when she looked at Xu Tian, ​​the provocation in her eyes was obviously much less intense, and even a little awe-inspiring.
This is the influence of the top thirty-two members of the Golden Grand Prix.
